generation.scope: On any finite window with a full opposite root of finite rank-two locus, the saturated ideal of the doubled twenty points has a fixed symmetric submaximal-minor resolution. Linearizing its last map recovers the opposite Veronese exactly; lifting the middle syzygies proves uniqueness even against presentations with excess rank-two locus whenever their generic matrix rank is at least three. This gives full uniqueness for reduced roots. At all four generic slots of the fifteen-dimensional component the triple octic is unique, geometrically integral and normal.

open_mathematics: Eliminate lower-rank competitors on nonreduced configurations and analyze octics with positive-dimensional singular loci and remaining components.
